subject.title: fix(infra): fix exec-approvals async lock, not just the sync path (#106777, extends #108971)

question: Which single PR should be the canonical exec-approvals lock fix after enforcing fail-closed behavior across awaited async callbacks?
rationale: Both open branches address the same authorization-store defect, but the correct async re-entrancy boundary is security-sensitive and selecting one implementation determines the permanent lock protocol.

options.title: Harden this PR
options.body: Apply the async-prefix-only held-lock rule and focused regressions here, then provide current-head real behavior proof before reviewing it as the canonical fix.

options.title: Adopt the competing hardening PR
options.body: Select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111368 after it supplies sufficient real behavior proof and its broader lock protocol receives security-owner review.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Keep the bug tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106777 until an owner chooses the intended authorization-lock protocol.

recommendation.title: Harden this PR
recommendation.body: Apply the async-prefix-only held-lock rule and focused regressions here, then provide current-head real behavior proof before reviewing it as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor supplied the production reproduction and the initial implementation that the competing branch explicitly credits.
